list.name: car_id

list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, name || CASE WHEN sold_at IS NOT NULL THEN ' (sold)' ELSE '' END AS __text FROM garagebooks.car ORDER BY id;

list.name: category

list.definition: SELECT name FROM (SELECT name, sort_order AS s FROM garagebooks.category UNION ALL SELECT 'Charging', 1000) x GROUP BY name ORDER BY min(s), name
list.description: Limits the headline figures (cost totals, per km, per day, per month) to these categories. Charging counts as its own category. Distance and time owned are not affected.

panels.title: Total cost
panels.description: Purchase + running expenses + charging. All-time (ignores the dashboard time range). Follows the Category filter. Less the sale price once the car is sold, while a purchase category is ticked.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'purchase' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'running' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'energy' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT CASE WHEN 'Charging' IN ($category) THEN teslamate_charging_total ELSE 0 END FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id) - COALESCE((SELECT sale_price FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), 0) * (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM garagebooks.category WHERE kind = 'purchase' AND name IN ($category)))::int)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'purchase' AND c.name IN ($category))

targets.rawSql: SELECT distance_km FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id

panels.title: Time owned
panels.description: Time since purchase (the first expense in a capital-cost category), else since TeslaMate's first position. Not affected by the Category filter. Stops at the sale date once the car is sold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN y > 0 THEN y || CASE WHEN y = 1 THEN ' year' ELSE ' years' END || CASE WHEN m > 0 THEN ', ' || m || CASE WHEN m = 1 THEN ' month' ELSE ' months' END ELSE '' END ELSE m || CASE WHEN m = 1 THEN ' month' ELSE ' months' END END FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a)::int AS y, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM a)::int AS m FROM (SELECT age(COALESCE(owned_until, now()), owned_since) AS a FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id) x) t

panels.title: Cost per km — all-in
panels.description: Total cost of ownership ÷ distance owned. Includes the purchase price. All-time (ignores the dashboard time range). Follows the Category filter. Less the sale price once the car is sold, while a purchase category is ticked.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'purchase' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'running' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'energy' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT CASE WHEN 'Charging' IN ($category) THEN teslamate_charging_total ELSE 0 END FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id) - COALESCE((SELECT sale_price FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), 0) * (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM garagebooks.category WHERE kind = 'purchase' AND name IN ($category)))::int) / NULLIF((SELECT distance_km FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), 0)

panels.title: Cost per km — running
panels.description: (Running expenses + charging) ÷ distance owned. Excludes the purchase price. All-time (ignores the dashboard time range). Follows the Category filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'running' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'energy' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT CASE WHEN 'Charging' IN ($category) THEN teslamate_charging_total ELSE 0 END FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id)) / NULLIF((SELECT distance_km FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), 0)

panels.title: Running cost per month
panels.description: (Running expenses + charging) ÷ months owned. Excludes the purchase price. All-time (ignores the dashboard time range). Follows the Category filter. Stops at the sale date once the car is sold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'running' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'energy' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT CASE WHEN 'Charging' IN ($category) THEN teslamate_charging_total ELSE 0 END FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id)) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE((SELECT owned_until FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), now()) - (SELECT owned_since FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id)) / 2629746, 1)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'running' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind = 'energy' AND c.name IN ($category)) + (SELECT CASE WHEN 'Charging' IN ($category) THEN teslamate_charging_total ELSE 0 END FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id)) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE((SELECT owned_until FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), now()) - (SELECT owned_since FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id)) / 86400, 1)

panels.title: Sold
panels.description: When the car sold and for how much (set on the Cars page). A dash while you still own it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Sold ' || to_char(sold_at AT TIME ZONE '$tz', 'FMDD Mon YYYY') || ' · ' || chr(36) || CASE WHEN sale_price = trunc(sale_price) THEN to_char(sale_price, 'FM999,999,999,990') ELSE to_char(sale_price, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') END FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id AND sold_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Running costs by category
panels.description: Excludes the purchase price. Respects the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "Category", SUM("Cost") AS "Cost" FROM (
  SELECT c.name AS "Category", SUM(e.amount) AS "Cost"
  FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id
  WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind IN ('running', 'energy') AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)
  GROUP BY c.name
  /*teslamate*/ UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Charging', SUM(cp.cost) FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = (SELECT teslamate_car_id FROM garagebooks.car WHERE id = $car_id) AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
  HAVING SUM(cp.cost) IS NOT NULL /*end*/
) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Running costs per $period
panels.description: Stacked by category, plus charging. Excludes the purchase price.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, SUM(value) AS value FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('$period', e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time, c.name AS metric, SUM(e.amount) AS value
  FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id
  WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind IN ('running', 'energy') AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  /*teslamate*/ UNION ALL
  SELECT date_trunc('$period', (cp.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE '$tz'), 'Charging', SUM(cp.cost)
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = (SELECT teslamate_car_id FROM garagebooks.car WHERE id = $car_id) AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(cp.cost) IS NOT NULL /*end*/
) x GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cumulative cost of ownership
panels.description: Running total of everything spent, stepping up once per $period.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('$period', e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS t, SUM(e.amount) AS a
  FROM garagebooks.expense e WHERE e.car_id = $car_id GROUP BY 1
  /*teslamate*/ UNION ALL
  SELECT date_trunc('$period', (cp.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE '$tz'), SUM(cp.cost)
  FROM charging_processes cp WHERE cp.car_id = (SELECT teslamate_car_id FROM garagebooks.car WHERE id = $car_id) GROUP BY 1 /*end*/
)
SELECT t AS time, SUM(SUM(a)) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS "Cumulative cost"
FROM m WHERE a IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Running costs per FBT year
panels.description: Stacked by category, plus charging, for each FBT year (1 April to 31 March), worked out from each expense's date in the dashboard's time zone. Excludes the purchase price. The time range above still limits what is counted, so a part-year at either end is a part-year.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'FBT ' || y || '–' || lpad(((y + 1) % 100)::text, 2, '0') AS "FBT year", metric AS "Category", SUM(value) AS "Cost"
FROM (
  SELECT garagebooks.fbt_year((e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date) AS y, c.name AS metric, SUM(e.amount) AS value
  FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id
  WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind IN ('running', 'energy') AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  /*teslamate*/ UNION ALL
  SELECT garagebooks.fbt_year(((cp.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date), 'Charging', SUM(cp.cost)
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = (SELECT teslamate_car_id FROM garagebooks.car WHERE id = $car_id) AND $__timeFilter(cp.start_date)
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(cp.cost) IS NOT NULL /*end*/
) x GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY min(y), 2

panels.title: Reminders
panels.description: What is open for this car, most urgent first. Add, edit and resolve reminders in GarageBooks (link at the top). The odometer is TeslaMate's or your latest reading; with none known, an odometer reminder says so.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (SELECT current_km FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id),
r AS (
  SELECT d.title, d.due_date, d.due_km, d.lead_days, d.lead_km, d.informational,
         (d.due_date - (now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date) AS days_left,
         d.due_km - o.current_km AS km_left
  FROM garagebooks.reminder_due d LEFT JOIN o ON true
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
), s AS (
  SELECT r.*,
         LEAST(CASE WHEN days_left < 0 THEN 0 WHEN days_left <= lead_days THEN 1 WHEN days_left IS NOT NULL THEN 2 END,
               CASE WHEN km_left <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN km_left <= lead_km THEN 1 WHEN km_left IS NOT NULL THEN 2 END) AS worst
  FROM r
)
SELECT title AS "Reminder", to_char(due_date, 'DD Mon YYYY') AS "Due date", due_km AS "Due km", days_left AS "Days left", round(km_left::numeric, 0) AS "Km left",
       CASE WHEN informational THEN 'Provider renews' WHEN worst = 0 THEN 'Overdue' WHEN worst = 1 THEN 'Due soon'
            WHEN worst = 2 THEN 'Upcoming' ELSE 'Odometer unknown' END AS "Status"
FROM s
ORDER BY CASE WHEN informational THEN 3 ELSE COALESCE(worst, 1) END, days_left NULLS LAST, km_left NULLS LAST, title

panels.title: Expenses
panels.description: Every recorded expense in the time range. Add or edit them in GarageBooks (link at the top).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.occurred_at AS "Date", c.name AS "Category", e.vendor AS "Vendor", e.amount AS "Amount",
       e.odometer_km AS "Odometer", CASE WHEN e.invoice_path IS NOT NULL THEN rtrim(${app_url:sqlstring}, '/') || '/invoice/' || e.id ELSE e.invoice_url END AS "Invoice",
       e.notes AS "Notes"
FROM garagebooks.expense e JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id
WHERE e.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(e.occurred_at)
ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC

panels.title: Kilometre pace
panels.description: This FBT year's distance against the estimated km per year, pro rata for the days held. A year with two leases adds both parts up, each with its own estimate and days. Empty when no lease held in this FBT year has an estimate. The odometer is TeslaMate's or your latest reading; a figure that needs one that isn't known is blank, not 0. Same figures as the FBT year page in GarageBooks.

matcher.options: Km per day needed from today

targets.rawSql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT t.today, garagebooks.fbt_year(t.today) AS yr, make_date(garagebooks.fbt_year(t.today), 4, 1) AS y0,
         make_date(garagebooks.fbt_year(t.today) + 1, 3, 31) AS y1,
         make_date(garagebooks.fbt_year(t.today) + 1, 4, 1) - make_date(garagebooks.fbt_year(t.today), 4, 1) AS in_year
  FROM (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date AS today) t
), p AS (
  SELECT ls.estimated_km_per_year::numeric AS est, y.*, GREATEST(ls.start_date, y.y0) AS d0, LEAST(ls.end_date, y.y1) AS d1
  FROM garagebooks.lease ls CROSS JOIN y
  WHERE ls.car_id = $car_id AND ls.estimated_km_per_year IS NOT NULL AND ls.start_date <= y.y1 AND ls.end_date >= y.y0
), q AS (
  SELECT p.*, p.d1 - p.d0 + 1 AS held, GREATEST(LEAST(p.today, p.d1 + 1) - p.d0, 0) AS elapsed, p.today < p.d0 AS upcoming
  FROM p
), o AS (
  SELECT q.*,
         CASE WHEN NOT q.upcoming THEN garagebooks.odometer_at($car_id, q.d0::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::numeric END AS s,
         CASE WHEN NOT q.upcoming THEN garagebooks.odometer_at($car_id, LEAST(now(), (q.d1 + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))::numeric END AS c
  FROM q
), a AS (
  SELECT min(yr) AS yr, sum(held) AS held, sum(elapsed) AS elapsed,
         sum(est * held / in_year) AS expected, sum(est * elapsed / in_year) AS so_far,
         (array_agg(s ORDER BY d0))[1] AS s,
         CASE WHEN bool_and(upcoming) OR bool_or(NOT upcoming AND (s IS NULL OR c IS NULL)) THEN NULL
              ELSE sum(CASE WHEN upcoming THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(c - s, 0) END) END AS driven
  FROM o HAVING count(*) > 0
)
SELECT 'FBT ' || yr || '–' || to_char((yr + 1) % 100, 'FM00') AS "FBT year",
       round(expected, 1) AS "Expected km", round(s, 1) AS "Odometer at start", round(s + expected, 1) AS "Odometer needed at end",
       round(expected / held, 1) AS "Km per day needed", round(driven, 1) AS "Driven so far",
       round(driven / NULLIF(elapsed, 0), 1) AS "Km per day driven", round(driven - so_far, 1) AS "Ahead (+) or behind (-)",
       round(CASE WHEN driven IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(expected - driven, 0) END / NULLIF(held - elapsed, 0), 1) AS "Km per day needed from today"
FROM a

panels.title: Running costs after tax
panels.description: What the running costs entered for this car (and TeslaMate's charging) come to on the invoices, and what they cost after tax: an expense paid from the package has its GST claimed back and the rest comes from pre-tax salary. All-time (ignores the dashboard time range). Follows the Category filter. A dash while a packaged expense can't be worked out. Cost after tax is worked out from the marginal tax rate saved in GarageBooks' Settings and each lease's pre-tax and post-tax payments (see the documentation); it is not tax advice. The home charging reimbursement needs the odometer, so it is shown in GarageBooks (the FBT year report), not here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.amount, t.packaged, t.effective_cost
  FROM garagebooks.expense_after_tax('$tz') t
  JOIN garagebooks.expense e ON e.id = t.expense_id JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id
  WHERE t.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind IN ('running', 'energy') AND c.name IN ($category)
), tm AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN 'Charging' IN ($category) THEN COALESCE((SELECT teslamate_charging_total FROM garagebooks.ownership WHERE car_id = $car_id), 0) ELSE 0 END AS v
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.amount), 0) + (SELECT v FROM tm) AS "Invoices",
       CASE WHEN bool_or(x.packaged AND x.effective_cost IS NULL) THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(SUM(x.effective_cost), 0) + (SELECT v FROM tm) END AS "After tax"
FROM x

panels.title: After tax by FBT year
panels.description: Each FBT year (1 April to 31 March, from each expense's date in the dashboard's time zone): the running costs on the invoices (TeslaMate's charging included), what they cost after tax, and the difference. Ignores the dashboard time range. A dash where a packaged expense can't be worked out. Cost after tax is worked out from the marginal tax rate saved in GarageBooks' Settings and each lease's pre-tax and post-tax payments (see the documentation); it is not tax advice. The home charging reimbursement needs the odometer, so it is shown in GarageBooks (the FBT year report), not here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'FBT ' || y || '–' || lpad(((y + 1) % 100)::text, 2, '0') AS "FBT year",
       SUM(invoice) AS "Invoices",
       CASE WHEN bool_or(missing) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(effective) END AS "After tax",
       CASE WHEN bool_or(missing) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(invoice) - SUM(effective) END AS "Saved"
FROM (
  SELECT garagebooks.fbt_year((t.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date) AS y, t.amount AS invoice,
         COALESCE(t.effective_cost, 0) AS effective, (t.packaged AND t.effective_cost IS NULL) AS missing
  FROM garagebooks.expense_after_tax('$tz') t
  JOIN garagebooks.expense e ON e.id = t.expense_id JOIN garagebooks.category c ON c.id = e.category_id
  WHERE t.car_id = $car_id AND c.kind IN ('running', 'energy')
  /*teslamate*/ UNION ALL
  SELECT garagebooks.fbt_year(((cp.start_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE '$tz')::date), cp.cost, cp.cost, false
  FROM charging_processes cp
  WHERE cp.car_id = (SELECT teslamate_car_id FROM garagebooks.car WHERE id = $car_id) AND cp.cost IS NOT NULL /*end*/
) x GROUP BY y ORDER BY y
